name: Kenya Pipeline Company Plc
source: Kenya Pipeline Company Plc consolidated audited financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026 (condensed consolidated statement of financial position), printed in Kshs thousands and stored here as absolute KES. Total liabilities is the printed borrowings 442,861 plus other non-current liabilities 23,417,063 plus current liabilities 6,084,918; the components sum to 29,944,842 against 29,944,841 implied by total assets less shareholders equity, a one thousand shilling rounding difference in the condensed statement, so the figure that ties total assets to equity is stored. Non-current assets is property, plant and equipment 94,397,253 plus leasehold land 21,255,748 plus other non-current assets 3,586,335. No cash line is printed in the condensed statement, so Cash and Equivalents is left empty rather than estimated.
source_note: KShs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Year-end 30 June. Summary position: total assets, total liabilities, shareholders' funds (= net assets).
